consequences.explanation: The accepted constraint owns the required authored-format, schema, and hash behavior independently of implementation status.

Task 6A converts Projector's own authored files once only after the new reader, writer, schemas, and runtime validation work; it does not ship a permanent dual reader, converter, or sealed migration for that cutover.
The conversion preserves parsed identities, relationships, accepted meaning, rationale, and unrealized commitments, while journals and receipts retain their existing authentication semantics.

payload.decision: Use TOML for human-authored Projector configuration and canonical artifacts. Keep machine or external contracts in JSON when that remains useful and keep SQLite derived. Give canonical files readable, deterministic filenames derived from stable record identities; keys aid discovery but do not own paths. Serialize with deliberate field ordering and readable multiline prose. Parse TOML to values and validate those values with the existing typed Zod contracts at runtime. Generate explicit versioned JSON Schemas from those same contracts, package the exact bundle, copy it to `.projector/schemas`, and add a document-relative Taplo `#:schema` header to every authored TOML file without editing user `.taplo.toml`. Compute semantic, discovery, and canonical value hashes from normalized parsed values so comments and formatting do not affect meaning or currentness. Preserve exact-byte checks in authenticated plans, executable inputs, and recovery journals. Ordinary authored edits require no manual hash maintenance, while parsing or hash agreement does not establish correctness, reviewed acceptance, approval, authorization, fidelity, or provenance. A Projector rewrite need not preserve arbitrary comment placement or lexical ordering. Runtime validation works without an editor; automatic schema association is supported only where Taplo-compatible tooling is installed, and semantic validation errors guarantee file and field paths rather than source spans.
payload.title: Use typed TOML for authored project artifacts
